name: awge
title: AWGE
description: Manage AWG Manager routing and router storage from Raycast
author: wsb

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: AWGM API URL
preferences.description: API base URL for your AWG Manager installation.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: AWGM API Key
preferences.description: Only needed if AWGM web authorization is enabled. Use the API Key from AWGM Settings.

preferences.name: defaultRuleName
preferences.title: Default HR Neo Rule
preferences.description: Optional when only one HR Neo rule is enabled; set once if there are several.

preferences.name: routerSshHost
preferences.title: Router SSH Host
preferences.description: SSH host or alias from your SSH configuration. Required for storage commands.

preferences.name: tpRuleSetName
preferences.title: TProxy Ruleset
preferences.description: Exact inline Sing-box ruleset name. Required for TProxy commands.

commands.name: add-safari-domain
commands.title: add to HR
commands.description: Add Safari's current hostname to AWG Manager HR Neo

commands.name: add-to-tp
commands.title: add to TP
commands.description: Route Safari's current hostname through a Sing-box TProxy profile

commands.name: remove-safari-domain
commands.title: remove from HR
commands.description: Remove Safari's current hostname from the matching HR Neo rule

commands.name: remove-from-tp
commands.title: remove from TP
commands.description: Remove Safari's current hostname from the Sing-box TProxy profile

commands.name: add-to-zapret
commands.title: add to zapret
commands.description: Add Safari's current hostname to Zapret's editable user hostlist

commands.name: eject-router-drive
commands.title: eject drive
commands.description: Unmount a USB partition while keeping its device connected to the router

commands.name: drive-settings
commands.title: drive settings
commands.description: Lock or unlock router storage partitions
